name: fellowship-tests
description: Shows the project's Unreal automation tests in VS Code's Testing view and runs or debugs them headless.

fellowshipTests.engineDir.description: Root folder of the Unreal Engine install used to build and run the tests.

fellowshipTests.buildBeforeRun.description: Build the editor target before running tests. If the editor is open with Live Coding, the build is refused and the tests run on the binaries already on disk.

fellowshipTests.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to the editor that runs the tests.
